# Klavity AutoSim API — full reference

Base URL: `https://klavity.in`
Auth (every endpoint): `Authorization: Bearer kci_<token>`
Machine-readable contract: `https://klavity.in/openapi.json` (OpenAPI 3.1)

Klavity AutoSim drives your real web UI with an AI agent, verifies an objective,
and files structured findings. Two REST surfaces exist:

- `/api/v1/*` — the current contract (use this).
- `/api/ci/*` — legacy trigger alias, still supported (see /docs/ci-api.md).

There is also an MCP server at `POST /mcp` exposing the same capability as tools
(see /docs/mcp.md).

---

## Authentication & scoping

- Header: `Authorization: Bearer kci_<token>`. Missing/invalid → `401`.
- The token is bound to ONE project. Every write takes `project_id` in the body;
  every read takes `?project=<id>` in the query. A mismatch with the token's
  project → `403`.
- Get / revoke tokens: Klavity dashboard → Settings → "API tokens".
- Error envelope (all errors): `{ "error": { "code": "...", "message": "...", "request_id": "abcd1234" } }`.

---

## Endpoints

### POST /api/v1/authored-runs
Objective-driven run: give a URL and a plain-English objective; the engine
authors a Trail AND runs a verification walk. Rate limit: 10/min/project.

Request body:
```json
{
  "project_id": "proj_...",        // required, must match token
  "target_url": "https://app.example.com/checkout",  // required, http(s), <=500 chars
  "objective": "Sign in and confirm the checkout total matches the cart",  // required, 10-4000 chars
  "name": "optional run name",
  "test_account": { "email": "...", "password": "..." }  // optional, for auth walls
}
```
Optional header `Idempotency-Key: <=200 chars` (safe retries; replay returns 200 with `idempotent_replay: true`).

Response `202`:
```json
{ "authored_run_id": "aut_...", "status": "authoring", "status_url": "/api/v1/authored-runs/aut_..." }
```
Errors: `400 bad_request`, `402 plan_required`, `403 forbidden`, `409 busy|idempotency_conflict`, `500 internal`.

### GET /api/v1/authored-runs/:id?project=:id
Response `200`:
```json
{
  "authored_run_id": "aut_...",
  "status": "authoring|completed|failed|needs_auth|cancelled",
  "trail_id": "trl_...|null",
  "verification_run_id": "walk_...|null",
  "verdict": "green|amber|red|skip|null",
  "objective_verified": true,
  "stall_reason": null,
  "created_at": 0, "updated_at": 0
}
```
When `status == completed`, use `verification_run_id` as the run id for the report endpoint below. `404 not_found` if unknown.

### POST /api/v1/authored-runs/:id/cancel?project=:id
Best-effort cooperative cancel. Response `200`: authored-run status + `cancel_requested: bool`.

---

### POST /api/v1/runs
Re-run an existing Trail. Rate limit: 30/min/project.

Request body:
```json
{
  "project_id": "proj_...",   // required, must match token
  "trail_id": "trl_...",      // required
  "git": { "sha": "abc123", "pr": "42", "branch": "main" }  // optional metadata
}
```
Optional header `Idempotency-Key`.

Response `202`:
```json
{
  "run_id": "walk_...",
  "status": "queued",
  "status_url": "/api/v1/runs/walk_...",
  "report_url": "/api/v1/runs/walk_.../report",
  "git": { "sha": "abc123", "pr": "42", "branch": "main" }
}
```
Errors: `400 bad_request`, `403 forbidden`, `404 not_found` (trail), `409 run_busy|trail_paused|plan_locked|idempotency_conflict`, `500 internal`.

### GET /api/v1/runs?project=:id
List recent runs. Query: `project` (required), `limit` (default 20, 1-100).
Response `200`:
```json
{ "runs": [ { "run_id": "walk_...", "trail_id": "trl_...", "status": "...", "verdict": "...", "started_at": 0, "finished_at": 0 } ] }
```

### GET /api/v1/runs/:id?project=:id
Response `200`:
```json
{
  "run_id": "walk_...",
  "trail_id": "trl_...",
  "status": "queued|running|completed|failed|cancelled",
  "verdict": "green|amber|red|skip|null",
  "summary": { "counts_by_severity": { "C1": 0, "C2": 1, "C3": 2 } },
  "started_at": 0, "finished_at": 0,
  "git": { "sha": "...", "pr": "...", "branch": "..." }
}
```
`verdict` is null until terminal. `404 not_found` if unknown.

### GET /api/v1/runs/:id/report?project=:id
Cursor-paginated findings. Query: `project` (required), `limit` (default 50, 1-200), `cursor` (opaque keyset from `next_cursor`).
Response `200`:
```json
{
  "run_id": "walk_...",
  "verdict": "green|amber|red|skip|null",
  "issues": [
    {
      "id": "...",
      "severity": "C1|C2|C3",
      "title": "...",
      "description": "...",
      "target": { "url": "...", "selector": "..." },
      "evidence": { "screenshot_url": "...", "replay_url": "..." },
      "ground_quote": "verbatim UI text the finding is grounded in"
    }
  ],
  "next_cursor": "..."   // pass back as ?cursor= to page; null/absent when done
}
```

### POST /api/v1/runs/:id/cancel?project=:id
Best-effort cancel. Response `200`: `{ "run_id": "...", "status": "...", "cancel_requested": true }`.

Status enums:
- run `status`: `queued | running | completed | failed | cancelled`
- `verdict` (terminal): `green` (pass) | `amber` (self-healed drift / warn) | `red` (regression) | `skip` (no steps) | `null` (not terminal yet)

---

## Tickets

Project-scoped bug/report tickets. The `kci_` token IS the project — do NOT pass a `?project=` param
on these routes. Every `:id` route is IDOR-guarded: a ticket id owned by another project returns `404`.
Any project member may create/update tickets and add comments; assigning a ticket to a NON-member
requires an admin token (→ `403`).

Ticket shape:
```json
{ "id": "fb_...", "seq_num": 42, "title": "...", "description": "...",
  "status": "open", "priority": "high", "assignee": "dev@acme.com",
  "source": "manual", "labels": [{ "id": "...", "name": "...", "color": "#f00" }],
  "recurrence": 1, "created_at": 1700000000000, "updated_at": 1700000000000 }
```
Enums: `status` = `new | open | in_progress | done | dismissed`; `priority` = `urgent | high | medium | low`;
`source` = `sim | manual | human`.

### GET /api/v1/tickets
List tickets. Query filters: `status` (comma-separated), `priority` (comma-separated), `assignee`
(exact email; empty string = unassigned), `source` (`sim|manual|human`), `label` (label id), `q`
(free-text search), `page` (default 1), `limit` (≤200, default 50). Response `200`:
`{ "tickets": [Ticket], "total": 123, "page": 1, "limit": 50 }`.

### POST /api/v1/tickets
Create a ticket. Body: `{ "title": "…" (≤500, required), "assignee": "dev@acme.com" (email, required),
"description": "…" (≤5000), "priority": "urgent|high|medium|low" (default medium) }`. Rate limit:
30/min/project. Response `201`: `{ "ticket_id": "fb_..." }`.

### GET /api/v1/tickets/:id
Enriched single ticket. Response `200`: the Ticket shape plus
`{ "comments_count": 3, "attachments": [{ "name": "log.txt", "url": "https://…", "content_type": "text/plain" }],
"replay_url": "/api/v1/tickets/:id/replay" | null }`. Attachment URLs are short-lived presigned links.

### PATCH /api/v1/tickets/:id
Update. Body may include any of: `status`, `priority`, `assignee`, `notes`, `description`. Assigning to
a non-member requires an admin token. Response `200`: `{ "ok": true, "ticket": Ticket }`.

### GET /api/v1/tickets/:id/comments
Response `200`: `{ "ticket_id": "…", "comments": [{ "id": "…", "author": "…", "body": "…", "created_at": 170… }] }`.

### POST /api/v1/tickets/:id/comments
Body: `{ "body": "…" (≤5000, required) }`. Comments are pushed to any linked external trackers.
Response `201`: `{ "comment": { "id": "…", "author": "…", "body": "…", "created_at": 170… } }`.

### GET /api/v1/tickets/:id/activity
Merged timeline (comments + status/priority/assignee activity + connector exports). Response `200`:
`{ "ticket_id": "…", "events": [ … ] }`.

---

## Minimal agent loop (bash)

```bash
BASE=https://klavity.in
TOK=kci_YOUR_TOKEN
PID=proj_YOUR_PROJECT

# 1. Trigger an objective-driven run
AUT=$(curl -sf -X POST "$BASE/api/v1/authored-runs" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOK" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d "{\"project_id\":\"$PID\",\"target_url\":\"https://app.example.com\",\"objective\":\"Sign in and reach the dashboard\"}" \
  | jq -r '.authored_run_id')

# 2. Poll authoring → get the verification run id
while :; do
  S=$(curl -sf "$BASE/api/v1/authored-runs/$AUT?project=$PID" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOK")
  ST=$(echo "$S" | jq -r '.status'); echo "authored: $ST"
  [ "$ST" != "authoring" ] && break; sleep 8
done
RUN=$(echo "$S" | jq -r '.verification_run_id')

# 3. Poll the run to completion
while :; do
  R=$(curl -sf "$BASE/api/v1/runs/$RUN?project=$PID" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOK")
  RS=$(echo "$R" | jq -r '.status'); echo "run: $RS"
  case "$RS" in completed|failed|cancelled) break;; esac; sleep 8
done

# 4. Pull findings to work on
curl -sf "$BASE/api/v1/runs/$RUN/report?project=$PID" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOK" | jq '.issues'
```

---

## CI/CD templates

### GitHub Actions (.github/workflows/klavity.yml)
```yaml
name: Klavity AutoSim
on: [deployment_status]        # or: workflow_dispatch / push
jobs:
  autosim:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Run Klavity Trail
        env:
          BASE: https://klavity.in
          TOK: ${{ secrets.KLAVITY_CI_TOKEN }}
          PID: ${{ secrets.KLAVITY_PROJECT_ID }}
          TRAIL: ${{ secrets.KLAVITY_TRAIL_ID }}
        run: |
          RUN=$(curl -sf -X POST "$BASE/api/v1/runs" \
            -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOK" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d "{\"project_id\":\"$PID\",\"trail_id\":\"$TRAIL\",\"git\":{\"sha\":\"$GITHUB_SHA\",\"branch\":\"$GITHUB_REF_NAME\"}}" \
            | jq -r '.run_id')
          for i in $(seq 1 40); do
            V=$(curl -sf "$BASE/api/v1/runs/$RUN?project=$PID" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOK")
            ST=$(echo "$V" | jq -r '.status'); echo "status: $ST"
            case "$ST" in completed|failed|cancelled) break;; esac; sleep 10
          done
          VERDICT=$(echo "$V" | jq -r '.verdict')
          echo "verdict: $VERDICT"
          curl -sf "$BASE/api/v1/runs/$RUN/report?project=$PID" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOK" | jq '.issues'
          [ "$VERDICT" = "red" ] && exit 1 || exit 0   # fail the build on a regression
```

### GitLab CI (.gitlab-ci.yml)
```yaml
klavity_autosim:
  image: alpine:latest
  before_script: [ "apk add --no-cache curl jq" ]
  variables:
    BASE: "https://klavity.in"
  script:
    - |
      RUN=$(curl -sf -X POST "$BASE/api/v1/runs" \
        -H "Authorization: Bearer $KLAVITY_CI_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
        -d "{\"project_id\":\"$KLAVITY_PROJECT_ID\",\"trail_id\":\"$KLAVITY_TRAIL_ID\",\"git\":{\"sha\":\"$CI_COMMIT_SHA\",\"branch\":\"$CI_COMMIT_REF_NAME\"}}" \
        | jq -r '.run_id')
      for i in $(seq 1 40); do
        V=$(curl -sf "$BASE/api/v1/runs/$RUN?project=$KLAVITY_PROJECT_ID" -H "Authorization: Bearer $KLAVITY_CI_TOKEN")
        ST=$(echo "$V" | jq -r '.status'); echo "status: $ST"
        case "$ST" in completed|failed|cancelled) break;; esac; sleep 10
      done
      VERDICT=$(echo "$V" | jq -r '.verdict'); echo "verdict: $VERDICT"
      [ "$VERDICT" = "red" ] && exit 1 || exit 0
```

Set CI secrets `KLAVITY_CI_TOKEN`, `KLAVITY_PROJECT_ID`, `KLAVITY_TRAIL_ID`
(create a Trail once in the dashboard, or use `/api/v1/authored-runs` to author
one on the fly from an objective).

---

## MCP (Claude Code / Cursor)

`POST https://klavity.in/mcp` — JSON-RPC 2.0, same `kci_` bearer. Config:
```json
{ "mcpServers": { "klavity-autosim": {
  "type": "http", "url": "https://klavity.in/mcp",
  "headers": { "Authorization": "Bearer kci_YOUR_TOKEN" } } } }
```
Tools: `start_qa_run`, `start_authored_run`, `get_qa_run`, `get_qa_report`,
`get_authored_run`, `list_qa_runs`. Every tool takes `project_id`.
Full details: https://klavity.in/docs/mcp.md
